why: The quarter that holds the small shape is cut out, made big and painted black, and the small shape stays white inside it. In figure 3 the square sits in the bottom-left quarter of the circle, so we get a black quarter-circle with a white square: option 1. Option 2 has the right quarter and square but is not painted black.
trick: Find which part holds the small shape, then copy every change (size, colour) from the first pair.
